_about: Public-domain Thomas A. Jaggar, first Episcopal Bishop of Southern Ohio, for the Word Hoard: The Man of the Ages and Other Recent Sermons, The Personality of Truth, and occasional sermons in Pennsylvania and Montreal. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 126 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

jaggar-sermon-1865: A sermon (New York : R.C. Root, Anthony & Co., Printers, 1865)

jaggar-montreal: Sermons preached in Christ Church Cathedral, Montreal : "the presence of the comforter in the particular or national church" ([Montreal? : s.n.], 1883)
jaggar-man-of-ages: The man of the ages, and other recent sermons (New York, J. Pott & co., 1898)
jaggar-personality-truth: The personality of truth (New York : T. Whittaker, 1900)

_excluded.jaggar-geology: the geological works are by his son, the volcanologist Thomas A. Jaggar Jr.
